lines.text: Shh. We are filming the coziest October video in human history.
I'm wearing shorts.
It is fifty degrees, Owen.
Shorts season ends when I say it ends.
Okay. Slow and soft. Shot one, the first fall bake of the year.
A warm apple pie, cooling on a blanket. Steam rising. Very gentle.
Love that for the pie.
And now, the slow reveal.
Owen. Why is it just a crust?
I tested the filling. For quality.
You tested all of it?
Quality is a journey.
This is not a pie. This is a hat for a pie.
Put a leaf on it. Very October.
Fine. Shot two. I fall slowly into a big pile of leaves.
Soft music. Golden light. Total peace.
Rolling.
Here I go.
Hey! That is my house!
There's a squirrel in the leaves!
There is a squirrel in his living room. And now there is a lady in it.
I raked this pile myself. With my face. It took four days.
He's got a point. Look at his face.
Thank you. Finally, a man who sees me.
Do you live in every leaf pile in this park?
Just this one. I pay nothing. The rent is great.
Okay. Shot three. Cozy candle glow. Nothing can go wrong with a candle.
Oh, everything can go wrong with a candle, darling.
The candle talks?
I have been lit since August. Nobody has blown me out once.
I smell like a tired pie. Because I am tired, and I am a pie.
Same, buddy.
Please just glow. Softly. For eleven seconds.
I only glow when I am inspired.
Hello. Who is the warm lady?
Oh. Who is the furry gentleman in the little hat?
I live in a pile. I'm a homeowner.
A homeowner. Say less.
No. Nobody falls in love in my shot.
Babe, that is the whole trend.
I need sweaters. I need slow walks. I need you in long pants.
That is a lot of needs for a Thursday.
Fine. Let me just watch what we got.
Wait. Every single shot. They are in the background.
The squirrel is holding the candle's hand.
I don't have hands. He is holding my lid.
Very slowly. Golden light. Total peace.
That is my line.
Wait, this is posted. Owen, did you post this?
A million views. Every comment says protect the squirrel.
Nobody has ever protected me. I live in leaves.
So my cozy video is a squirrel love story.
Our love story was messy too. Remember?
Last October. You walked right through my apple orchard shot. In shorts.
And you yelled at me for twenty minutes.
Then you carried my pumpkins to the car.
And I ate your pie. Some traditions are sacred.
Okay. That is a little cozy.
And look. I put on a sweater. It's itchy. This is love.
I'll be lit until Christmas, darling.
Next October, we film. You two are the background.
